_comment: Editorial content for OML. Every fact here is attributable — see sourceNote. No image is attached: no licence-cleared photograph of this company's own facility exists on the open licence sources, and a generic industry photo would imply it is theirs.
description: Olympia Mills Limited was incorporated in 1960 as Olympia Spinning & Weaving Mills Limited and changed its name in November 2017 after shareholders approved a change of principal line of business. It is no longer a textile manufacturer: its business is the renting and leasing of its factory building and paper plant machinery at its Landhi Industrial Area site in Karachi.
headOffice: Plot No. H/23/3, Landhi Industrial Area, Karachi
sourceNote: Company website (olympiamills.com: group profile and shareholder contact) and the PSX company profile (dps.psx.com.pk/company/OML: business description, key people, address), read 2026-10-17.
